$comment: Raghbir, 19 Sep 2026: 'STOP ASKING ME TO APPROVE EVERY ACTION.'
permissions.defaultMode is 'acceptEdits'. It is the ONLY value that a
project settings file can set AND that a cloud session (claude.ai/code)
honours. Per the Claude Code permission-modes docs:
- 'auto' set in .claude/settings.json DOES NOT TAKE EFFECT.
- 'bypassPermissions' set here DOES NOT TAKE EFFECT either.
- 'dontAsk' AUTO-DENIES every call that would have prompted, and cloud
sessions ignore it from settings files anyway. It is not 'stop
asking', it is 'silently refuse', which is worse.
For a cloud session the mode dropdown (Auto) is the lever, not this file.
THE FOUR EXCEPTIONS BELOW ARE SAFE IN EVERY MODE. The docs list 'tools
matched by an explicit ask rule' among the actions NO mode auto-approves,
including bypassPermissions. So these still stop and ask:
deleting a Supabase project; dropping a table or column; deleting a
file Claude did not create; anything unrecoverable.
